title: Hon. BABS Attends Unveiling of 2027 CAN Calendar in Aborerin Zone, Eruwa
summary: Hon. Babatunde Ogunlade attended the unveiling of the Christian Association of Nigeria, Aborerin Zone, 2027 calendar at Jesus Healing Christ Church Aladura, Oke Aseye, Eruwa.

title: Hon. BABS Thanks Hon. Remi Oseni for Attending Reception of Father’s Burial Ceremony
summary: Ogunlade issued a message of appreciation following Hon. Remi Oseni’s attendance at the reception held for his late father, Pa Idowu Ishola Ogunlade.

title: More Than 100 NDC Members in Ibarapa East Announce Plans to Join APC
summary: More than 100 NDC members, including local and ward officers, announced an intention to join the APC; the announcement described a planned move, not a completed defection.

title: Drilling Works at Third Borehole Location in Anunimorigba Community, Lanlate, Completed
summary: A campaign update announced that drilling works at a third borehole location in Anunimorigba Community, Lanlate, had been completed.

title: APC Approves Drilling of Three New Boreholes Across Eruwa and Lanlate
summary: The campaign announced approval for three boreholes across Eruwa and Lanlate and said drilling had begun behind Baptist Day School, Sango Eruwa.

title: Hon. Babatunde Joins APC Leaders at Turbaning of Alhaji Lateef Ajiboye Akinsanya
summary: Ogunlade attended the installation of Alhaji Lateef Ajiboye Akinsanya as the first Aare Musulumi of Eruwaland and its environs.

title: Ibarapa East APC Campaign Council Calls for Calm over Disputed Billboard Posters
summary: The campaign council alleged that APM posters had been placed on an APC billboard and urged political actors to avoid actions that could heighten tensions.

title: Babatunde Adeyemi Mobilises Support for APC Candidates Ahead of 2027 Elections
summary: Eruwa-born businessman Babatunde Sunday Adeyemi is reported to be mobilising support for four APC figures contesting different offices ahead of 2027.

title: Babatunde Adeyemi Praises Turnout at APC Tour of Ibarapa
summary: Babatunde Sunday Adeyemi praised APC supporters’ turnout during a party tour and expressed confidence in Senator Sharafadeen Alli’s governorship bid.

title: Ogunlade Holds Engagements with Water Base Group and Lanlate Community Association
summary: The campaign reported meetings with the Water Base Group, Anunimorigba Landlord Association in Lanlate and other community groups.

title: Ogunlade Meets Executive Council of National Association of Lanlate Students
summary: Ogunlade, accompanied by members of the Patriotic Progressives Network, met the executive council of the National Association of Lanlate Students.

title: APC Campaign Council Reports Stakeholder Consultations in Ibarapa East
summary: The campaign council reported a consultative meeting involving APC candidates and traditional, religious, occupational, youth and student representatives.

title: Ibarapa East APC Youth Summit Holds with Adesoji Adedeji in Attendance
summary: A campaign statement thanked participants and organisers following an Ibarapa East APC Youth Summit attended by deputy governorship candidate Hon. Adesoji Adedeji.

title: Ogunlade Receives Senator Alli during Ibarapa East Consultative Tour
summary: Ogunlade reported receiving Senator Sharafadeen Alli and a delegation for consultations with traditional, religious, occupational and community stakeholders.

title: Ogunlade Welcomes Senator Sharafadeen Alli to Ibarapa
summary: Ogunlade issued a welcome message ahead of Senator Sharafadeen Alli’s visit to Ibarapa.

title: Ogunlade Joins Oyo APC Assembly Candidates at PBAT Walk with AlliSoji 2027
summary: Ogunlade reported participating in the PBAT Walk with AlliSoji 2027 alongside other Oyo State APC House of Assembly candidates.

title: MC Swagger Appointed Deputy Director-General of APC Ibarapa East Campaign Communications
summary: Amb. (Dr) Opeyemi Ayanrinde, known as MC Swagger, was reported appointed Deputy Director-General of Media and Strategic Communication for the APC Ibarapa East Campaign Council.

title: Ogunlade Commends Nigerian Army’s Civil-Military Project at Eruwa General Hospital
summary: Ogunlade commended the Nigerian Army’s civil-military project at Eruwa General Hospital, which the release said included hospital remodelling and a solar-powered borehole.

title: BABS Campaign Announces Ten-Ward Tour and Empowerment Programme
summary: The campaign announced a proposed week-long tour across Ibarapa East’s ten wards from 20 to 27 September 2026, with community meetings and planned welfare support.

title: APC Holds Reconciliation Meeting for Ibarapa East Aspirants and Stakeholders
summary: APC leaders, House of Assembly aspirants and stakeholders met in Ibarapa East as part of efforts to address internal differences ahead of the 2027 elections.

title: Ibarapa East APC Leaders Meet Ogunlade after INEC Nomination Form Presentation
summary: Ogunlade presented his INEC nomination form to senior APC leaders in Ibarapa East and sought their advice and support ahead of the 2027 election.

title: Ogunlade Congratulates Eleruwa on First Coronation Anniversary
summary: Ogunlade congratulated the Eleruwa of Eruwa, Oba Samuel Adebayo Adegbola Ajobo Olurin I, on the first anniversary of his coronation.
